system.description:
You spin and flail your weapon striking every surface in range generating sparks, smoke and dust creating a thick and difficult to see-through haze. This haze originates from a point of the space you are occupying and occupies a radius up to your weapons range in size.

This haze follows you and cannot be blown away by strong winds. Select one hostile creature you can see when you cast this jutsu. This creature cannot see through this haze and you are treated as being fully obscured visually against them. Creatures, their attacks and jutsu can still pass through this haze, entering and/or exiting it.

Chain 1: On each of your turns, for the duration, your first weapon or Taijutsu attack has a +1 bonus to its Critical threat range.

Chain 2: For the duration, when you score a critical hit, you gain invisibility and a +20-foot bonus to your movement speed until the end of the current turn.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target with this jutsu by +1.
